findings.evidence: MomentSpace.lean:113-115 (fields), :126 (`momentRhs` uses `S.alphaS (Real.exp τ)`), Basic.lean:272-273 (`integratedCoupling` integrand is `αs (Real.exp s)`); the structure's own docstring at :108 states "alphaS may be discontinuous at Q2 ≤ 0".
findings.fix: Carry the log-scale coupling as the field (`alphaSLogScale : ℝ → ℝ` with `Continuous alphaSLogScale`) and have `momentRhs`/`integratedCoupling` take it directly; recover a `Q2`-indexed view as a derived accessor where one is wanted. Alternatively keep `alphaS : RunningCoupling` but restore a law that constrains it on all of `ℝ`.
findings.issue: `alphaS : ℝ → ℝ` is free data off the positive axis. Every operation and law evaluates it only at `Real.exp τ` — `momentRhs` (line 126: `S.alphaS (Real.exp τ)`), `integratedCoupling` (Basic.lean:273: `∫ s in τ₀..τ, αs (Real.exp s) / (2 * π)`), hence `momentEvolution` — and this PR replaced the one law that pinned the rest (`alphaS_continuous : Continuous alphaS`) with `alphaS_logScale_continuous : Continuous fun τ => alphaS (Real.exp τ)`. Two systems with the same `gamma` and the same `alphaS ∘ exp` have identical evolution operators and identical solution sets but are unequal, so no useful `@[ext]` holds.

findings.evidence: MomentSpace.lean:501 (`coupling : S.alphaS = αs`), :536 (`simp only [momentRhs, momentVector, h.coupling, h.gamma_ofReal]` — every occurrence rewritten is `S.alphaS (Real.exp τ)`), Basic.lean:246 (`dglapRhsLogScale ... = αs (Real.exp τ) / (2 * Real.pi) * ...`).
findings.fix: Weaken the field to `coupling : ∀ τ : ℝ, S.alphaS (Real.exp τ) = αs (Real.exp τ)` (or to the composite field proposed above); the proof at line 536 rewrites `S.alphaS` only under `Real.exp τ` and goes through unchanged.
findings.issue: `coupling : S.alphaS = αs` requires equality of the full `ℝ → ℝ` functions, but `isMomentSolution_momentVector` uses it only under `Real.exp τ`, and `dglapRhsLogScale` likewise evaluates `αs` only at `Real.exp τ` (Basic.lean:246). This is the one place that still pins `S.alphaS` at `Q2 ≤ 0`, so a system packaging a coupling that agrees with the x-space `αs` only on positive scales — exactly the case the new `alphaS_logScale_continuous` field was introduced to admit — cannot satisfy `MomentReductionAssumptions`.

summary: The `momentEvolution`/`integratedCoupling` surface is minimal, bodies are hidden behind `_def` lemmas, and the characteristic API is complete and correctly annotated. But after this PR's field change, `DglapMomentSystem.alphaS` carries data no operation or law uses, and `MomentReductionAssumptions.coupling` still demands equality of the whole function, which cancels the generality the change was made to buy.
